newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila forges pact with banks on reverse repos.
newsitem.headline: Manila forges pact with banks on reverse repos.

text.p: The Philippine Central Bank said on Wednesday it had signed an agreement with commercial banks to open their books on the secondary trading of reverse repos.

Governor Gabriel Singson said in a statement the Central Bank forged an agreement with the Bankers Association of the Philippines to maintain a separate book for all reverse repurchase transactions for easy audit by the Bureau of Internal Revenue.
"The establishment of separate books shall start on September 15 and will cover reverse repos of six-day term and longer duration," Singson said.
The measure is being adopted by the Central Bank to help the government collect more interest income tax.
The finance department said recently it had lost about two billion pesos as some banks had not remitted interest income taxes from reverse repo transactions.
